speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin; to understand the severity of this jaundice, has your baby been feeding well, and are they having normal wet and dirty diapers?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding Jaundice (Suboptimal Intake Jaundice). Based on the weight gain (only ~134g over two weeks) and exclusive breastfeeding history, this indicates insufficient milk transfer rather than pathologic causes like blood group incompatibility.
